name: Kilnlight
summary: A multi-page furniture, ceramics and lighting store with shop, product pages, bag and checkout
about: A quiet-luxury home goods store built around arches and brass: a swinging pendant lamp lights the hero, a vase turns on a potter's wheel and a brass curtain sweeps between pages. Shoppers filter and sort fourteen pieces, zoom into product art, pick a finish and size, and check out in three steps. Good for a furniture, ceramics, lighting or home decor shop.
how: Browse the home page: nudge the swinging lamp, flip it off and on, drag the featured carousel and open journal notes.
Open the shop to filter by category, material, finish colour, price and stock, sort the results, switch grid or list, or open a quick view.
On a product page, choose a finish to recolour the art, pick a size to update the price, hover the image to zoom, then add it to the bag.
The bag drawer slides in: change quantities, remove pieces and try the promo code BRASS15 for 15% off.
Check out in three steps (details, delivery, payment). Place order runs through its stages and the pendant lights up with your order number.
With reduced motion the lamp stays still and there are no flights or embers, but every step still works.
